translation_review.checked_translation: (6) Acceptance of overseas clinical-trial data. Data from overseas multicentre clinical trials meeting China's registration requirements for medicines and medical devices may be used to apply for registration in China. When medicines or medical devices are first submitted for marketing in China, the registration applicant shall provide clinical-trial data on whether ethnic differences exist.
